source_method: Normalized cross-correlation of optic housing/rim. Half-resolution tracking with quadratic subpixel peak. Approximate visual feature motion, not recovered rig or player input.

window.uncertainty: Feature-center approx +/-3 px; individual crest timing approx +/-2 source frames. Input speed and walking/jogging label unavailable; no camera/world scale separation.

rejected_front_rail_tracking: Excluded from fitting: NCC dropped to0.356 under changing pose. No front-rail-fidelity claim.
reproduction: Feature templates are recorded as full-resolution bounds. Source motion was analyzed at half resolution; all reported coordinates are restored to1280x720. Linear drift was removed and a two-harmonic periodic model fit; data uncertainty is retained.
